alphabet_convention: Alphabet convention: Standard ASL manual alphabet A-Z; J and Z handled as dynamic gestures; M and N use standard ASL forms.
reviewer: Assistant visual inspection with an independent assistant second pass; not human ASL certification.
method: Inspect original pixels using standard ASL. Model/kNN disagreement is supporting triage evidence only. Occluded thumb paths and unresolved digit identities remain manual review. An image compatible with a label is not necessarily sufficient to confirm that label. No generative restoration or new landmark extraction.
